description1: We provide warranty and post-warranty service for safes, vault doors and locking systems. We diagnose faults, repair equipment and replace components to restore reliable operation and extend service life.
description2: We professionally install and replace mechanical and electronic locks for safes and vault equipment, selecting locking mechanisms suited to the construction and security requirements.
description3: We recode and configure mechanical and electronic combination locks, allowing access codes to be changed when responsible personnel change or security needs are updated.
description4: Regular maintenance helps ensure reliable operation. We inspect locking mechanisms, check functionality and make adjustments to help prevent failures and premature wear.
description5: If a mechanism jams, a key is lost or a locking system malfunctions, we provide professional assistance to restore access while seeking to minimize damage.
description6: We help select safes, vault doors and specialized equipment based on their intended use, installation conditions and required level of protection.
